title: Session Continuity Report
markdown:
# Session Continuity Health Check

**Check Date**: 2026-04-17T21:08:00Z
**Status**: ⚠ PARTIAL — Handoff infrastructure healthy, but learning extraction stale

## Findings

### ✓ Healthy

- **Job Execution**: 41 recent sessions (last 8h), all completed normally
  - Job sessions: 33 (all healthy cadence)
  - Telegram interactive: 8 (all completed)
- **Handoff Notes**: 12 updated since Apr 11, current across all job types
  - Latest: Apr 17 14:07 (git-sync, degradation-digest)
  - All contain actionable summaries for next runs
- **Git Commits**: Regular sync activity (14+ commits in last 12h)
- **Memory.md**: Last updated Apr 17 08:03 (reflection job ran)
- **Continuity Check**: Running automatically, confirmed healthy at 15:02 UTC

### ⚠ Stale

- **Learning Registry**: Last updated 2026-04-11 (6 days old)
  - 7 pending learnings still unapplied
  - Post-Apr-11 sessions not contributing new learnings to registry
  - Root cause: Reflection job ran per MEMORY.md, but learning-extractor may not be feeding new findings back
- **State Verification Timestamps**: quick-facts.json and project-registry.json dated 2026-03-08 (40 days old)

## Continuity Gap

Jobs ARE producing handoffs, but handoffs are NOT feeding into structured learnings. Recent insights from 41 sessions over 8 hours are becoming transaction logs (in handoff notes) but not crystallizing into design principles or patterns (in learning registry).

### What This Means

- **Transient intelligence loss**: If a handoff note isn't read before the next job runs, its insight evaporates
- **No accumulation**: The agent doesn't compound on recent work; each job starts fresh
- **Memory hygiene works but learnings don't**: MEMORY.md is pruned, but new learnings aren't being extracted from jobs to replace old static entries

## Recommendations

1. Verify reflection-trigger is running post-Apr-11 and why learning registry isn't updating
2. Check learning-extractor pipeline: handoff notes → learning registry → MEMORY.md
3. Auto-apply pending learnings: 7 learnings are pending, review and apply or archive each
4. Refresh state verification: quick-facts and project-registry dated 2026-03-08 (40 days old)
